search_scope: Existing Mao2023 lead, SBD novice interventions, and primary follow-up of Petrizzo2017 abstract. Not exhaustive.

reports.week_number_mapping: Training weeks1-8 correspond to study weeks3-10
conflicts: Methods describe >=72h test/training separation but section2.5 ends with 2-day pre/post-test intervals
Transition interval is described as 5min, alongside 2-3min before and after warmup
reports.decision: Retain S/B and set-failure evidence; not complete SBD programme
prohibited_inferences: Replace row with deadlift as if tested
Apply 10% reduction to pain or all failure contexts
Assume missed reps identify a cause

reports.title: A Feasibility Study Investigating the Sustainability and Safety of a Non-Periodized Protocol with Linear Load Progression during the Initial 12 Weeks of Strength Training
reports.locator: Methods: Subjects and Procedures; Results: Protocol Completion

bench_press.frequency: alternates with standing shoulder press between sessions

reports.initial_load: Coach-assessed heaviest five repetitions without form deterioration; not a percentage inferred from 1RM
reports.study_endpoint: 12 weeks or inability to continue chosen squat progression
reports.primary_outcome_scope: Sustainability of squat load progression; do not present as validated individual SBD strength prediction
reports.decision: Retain novice progression evidence; SBD-only adaptation requires separate review
prohibited_inferences: Remove OHP without documenting the programme change
Treat completer-only regression as validated individual prescription
Generalize supervised feasibility to unsupervised safety

related_abstract.cohort_identity: unconfirmed; do not count as independent replication
related_abstract.note: Abstract has inconsistent bench pre/post and percentage values; not used for outcome estimates

adoption_decisions.use_first_set_completion_to_increase_nex: rejected; all assigned sets and reps are the reported condition
adoption_decisions.no_ohp_product_scope: preserved; original OHP remains in evidence only
source_supported_choices: Petrizzo training frequency of 2 or 3 nonconsecutive days
Petrizzo participant-chosen progression increment and rest
remaining_product_decisions: SBD-only weekly workload after removal of OHP
Eligibility for user-confirmed progression after actual load changes

next_decision: Resolve SBD weekly workload and supervised-start applicability before creating a novice adapter; do not silently combine the two studies into a tested programme.
